posts.name: Nishita Jatinkumar Modh
posts.cooked:
The same query was posted on 6th February in Operational Issues categories. But did not find any solution there. As per the response received from support team via email, they asked to post it here in this category. I hope the issue would be solved before 20th February that is before the release of 1st BPT.

I am facing the below error since 6th February 2026.

image1920×1080 149 KB

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
I am able to access the webpage. Could you please try switching your network and browser? Even try once from your mobile and let me know if you are able to access?

Fixes include clearing browser/DNS cache, switching to public DNS (e.g., Google’s 8.8.8.8), or restarting the router.

posts.name: Nishita Jatinkumar Modh
posts.cooked: Thank you. I am able to login by switching to another network and clearing the browser cache
